summary.text: Larry Butler has represented the 72nd District in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 2007, after serving as a Waterbury alderman from 1997 to 2006.

paragraphs.text: He was born and raised in Waterbury, attended Central Connecticut State University and the Computer Processing Institute, and lists his occupation as computer software designer.
He serves on the Housing, Human Services, Finance, Revenue & Bonding and Legislative Management committees.
